description: "Life of Sir Walter Scott, with Abbotsford Notanda" by Robert Chambers and Robert Carruthers is a biographical account written in the late 19th century. This memoir explores the life of Sir Walter Scott, one of Scotland's most renowned novelists and poets, and includes insights into his residence at Abbotsford.
